subtitle: Out Manila · China Southern Airlines
overview: Fly via Guangzhou to Taiyuan and explore Shanxi: the walled Pingyao Ancient City, Guangsheng Temple’s Flying Rainbow Pagoda, Hukou Waterfall on the Yellow River, Yunqiu Mountain and its ice cave group, and Jinci Temple. Includes the Situ Town Iron Fireworks Show and local meals such as a Shanxi vinegar banquet. 5-star hotels and two complimentary bottles of water per person per day. A no-shopping package.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Nov 22–27 2026 to Nov 22–27 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Pingyao Ancient City: A well-preserved Ming and Qing walled town in Shanxi, a UNESCO World Heritage site; electric vehicles are included.
placeDesc.Ancient City Wall: The old defensive wall around Pingyao, one of the best-preserved city walls in China.
placeDesc.Rishengchang Exchange Shop: A historic Pingyao bank often described as China's first draft bank.
placeDesc.County Government Office: The old county yamen in Pingyao, showing how local officials worked in imperial times.
placeDesc.Guangsheng Temple: A Buddhist temple in Hongdong, Shanxi, known for its Flying Rainbow Pagoda.
placeDesc.Flying Rainbow Pagoda: A glazed-tile pagoda at Guangsheng Temple in Hongdong, decorated in several colours.
placeDesc.Hukou Waterfall: A large waterfall where the Yellow River narrows and drops; a shuttle bus is included.
placeDesc.Yunqiu Mountain: A scenic mountain in Shanxi with a Buddhist and Taoist heritage; a shuttle bus is included.
placeDesc.Tarpo Ancient Village: An old village on Yunqiu Mountain, visited on the Yunqiu Mountain day.
placeDesc.Yunqiu Mountain Ice Cave Group: A group of natural ice caves on Yunqiu Mountain, reached by shuttle bus.
placeDesc.Situ Town Iron Fireworks Show: An evening show in Situ Town where molten iron is flung against a wall to make sparks.
placeDesc.Bell Tower Street: A pedestrian street area of Taiyuan, offered as free time on the way back.
placeDesc.Willow Lane: An old-style lane in Taiyuan, part of the free time stop with Food Street.
placeDesc.Jinci Temple: A historic temple complex near Taiyuan with ancient halls and a spring; electric vehicles are included.
